labels: fixed globally fitted type_2023; retrospective transductive, with historical 2024 selection
features: frozen six X23 attributes reconstructed from model.npz, no refit
region_id: decimal registry region_code without padding, taken from pinned entity bridge
split: sort SHA256(task_id+"|"+canonical_region_id), then canonical ID for tie; first37 donor regions, remaining36 evaluation regions; require exactly73
predictor: unweighted median of observed donor outcomes
ties: stable argsort on lexicographic canonical panel entity_id; same ties for both methods
fallback: if fewer than15 donor entities share evaluation entity type_2023, use continuous15 and record fallback; no choosing K after outcomes
evaluation: exactly the same evaluation entities and donor pool for both methods
primary_metric: mean of within-evaluation-region municipality MAE; equal weight per region

bootstrap.unit: paired evaluation regions, resampled with replacement
bootstrap.interval: two-sided percentile95% of relative improvement; donor data and split held fixed
bootstrap.invalid: record zero baseline MAE or nonfinite draw; never replace by zero

operational_criterion: lower95% bound of relative improvement >0.05; this is a chosen operational threshold, not monetary value or causal effect
secondary: region leave-one-out, each type, low2023marketplace intensity decile, low observed2023population decile, Moscow and SPb intracity; descriptions without selecting winner or p-values
limitations: globally selected historical groups and scaler use 2023–2024 spending
regional dependence accounted only across sampled evaluation regions; cross-region spillovers not removed
no multi-hop or extra outcomes executed
